description: This Java class defines a command handler for inactivating a savings account charge within the Apache Fineract project. It processes commands to deactivate charges associated with savings accounts by invoking the appropriate service method.

classes.name: InactivateSavingsAccountChargeCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to inactivate savings account charges by delegating to the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to inactivate a savings account charge by calling the service method with the savings account ID and charge ID.
